asset.name: Stop-work alert
asset.description: Sent to the site manager and the inspector straight away when the outcome band is Stop work.
asset.subject: STOP WORK: {{site_row.name}} ({{inspection_ref}})
asset.html_body:
Stop work at {{site_row.name}}

The safety inspection on {{form.inspection_date}} found {{high_fails}} high-severity failure(s) (site condition {{form.site_condition}} of 5).

Stop the affected work now and make the area safe. Failed checks: {{fail_list}}.

Corrective actions are due within {{sla_days}} day(s); work may restart once the inspector has signed them off.

Inspection {{inspection_ref}} · sent by the site inspection workflow
